_comment: PINNED Cloudflare cache ruleset for dchub.cloud. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/check_cf_cache_ruleset.py --repin` AFTER an intentional rule change, and land the diff in a PR — this file is the only code review an edge change gets. Rule ORDER is significant: Cache Rules are last-match-wins.

rules.description: No cache auth
rules.expression:
(http.request.uri.path contains "/api/auth") or 
(http.request.uri.path contains "/api/login") or 
(http.request.uri.path contains "/api/register") or 
(http.request.uri.path contains "/api/user") or 
(http.request.uri.path contains "/api/stripe") or 
(http.request.uri.path contains "/api/checkout") or 
(http.request.uri.path contains "/mcp")

rules.description: Cache Public API (errors no-store, browser respects origin — 2026-07-03 fix-pack)
Cache Static Assets (browser respects origin so _headers immutable reaches browsers; errors no-store — 2026-07-03)
rules.expression:
(http.request.uri.path contains "/js/") or 
(http.request.uri.path contains "/css/") or 
(http.request.uri.path contains "/images/") or 
(ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".png")) or 
(ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpg")) or 
(ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpeg")) or 
(ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".svg")) or 
(ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ico")) or 
(ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webp")) or 
(ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff2")) or 
(ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff")) or 
(ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ttf"))

rules.description: Bypass cache - QA super-user board (live QA verdicts; Rule #3 override_origin was serving 17-42min stale) 2026-08-04

Bypass cache - liveness/ops endpoints (health, deadman, origin-freshness). A cached liveness probe reports the state of a past moment as the present one, which is the exact failure these endpoints exist to prevent. 2026-08-04

Bypass cache - /grid hub is TIER-VARYING (gates 7 of 9 ISO cards for free callers). Rule 5 Landing Pages cached it with override_origin, bulldozing the origin no-store, and a Pro X-API-Key render was served to anon. 2026-08-04

Bypass cache - /api/v1/admin/* — Rule 3 (Cache Public API, override_origin) cached an authenticated admin body and served it to an anonymous caller: HTTP 200, cf-cache-status HIT, age 1043. Worker half shipped in dchub-frontend#1176; _worker.js:659 records that both layers are required. 2026-08-12

Bypass cache for CREDENTIALED /api/v1/* (X-API-Key header or ?api_key=). 2026-09-06: Rule 2 (Cache Public API, override_origin) cached a developer-key 200 under an auth-blind key and served it byte-identical (1,003,630 B) to an anonymous caller the origin answers 401. CF ignores Vary other than Accept-Encoding and override_origin ignores no-store, and the edge cache sits IN FRONT of the Pages worker, so no _worker.js change can stop the HIT. Generic by credential rather than by path: rules 9/11/12/13/17/19/20/21/22/23 are the same class patched one prefix at a time. Worker half: dchub-frontend#1409. Origin gate: dchub-backend#4038.
